translations.literal: Every five days, on odd-numbered days behind the curtain at the Welcome-the-Sun Gate, the emperor sat north within the curtain; when the chief administrators reported business they provisionally removed left and right attendants;
translations.idiomatic: Every five days, on odd-numbered days the grand empress dowager held court behind the curtain at the Welcome-the-Sun Gate; the emperor sat north within the curtain; when chief administrators reported business, attendants were temporarily dismissed;

sentences.zh: 事有機速，許非時請對，及賜宣召，亦許升殿。

translations.literal: if affairs were urgent, out-of-season requests for audience were permitted, and when granted summons by edict, ascending the hall was also permitted.
translations.idiomatic: urgent matters permitted out-of-season audiences, and summoned officials might ascend the hall.

sentences.zh: 禮部、御史台、閣門奏討論御殿及垂簾儀制，每朔、望、六參，皇帝御前殿，百官起居，三省、樞密院奏事，應見、謝、辭班退，各令詣內東門進榜子。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites, Censorate, and palace gate reported deliberation on protocol for holding the main hall and behind-the-curtain rites: on each new moon, full moon, and six-attendance day the emperor held the front hall; the hundred officials performed attendance; the three provinces and Privy Council reported business; formations for audience, thanks, and leave-taking withdrew, each ordered to go to the inner eastern gate and submit placards.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites, Censorate, and gate office reported on main-hall and curtain protocol: on new moon, full moon, and six-attendance days the emperor held the front hall, officials attended, the three provinces and Privy Council reported business, and audience formations withdrew to submit placards at the inner eastern gate.

sentences.zh: 皇帝隻日御延和殿垂簾，日參官起居太皇太后，移班少西起居皇帝，並再拜。

translations.literal: On the emperor’s odd-numbered days he held the Hall of Extended Harmony behind the curtain; daily-attendance officials performed attendance to the grand empress dowager, shifted formation slightly west to perform attendance to the emperor, and all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: On the emperor’s odd-numbered days he held court behind the curtain at the Hall of Extended Harmony; daily-attendance officials attended the grand empress dowager, shifted slightly west to attend the emperor, and all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 三省、樞密院奏事，三日以上四拜，不舞蹈，候祔廟畢，起居如常儀。

translations.literal: When the three provinces and Privy Council reported business, for three days and above four bows, no dance; when enshrinement in the temple was finished, attendance followed the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: The three provinces and Privy Council reported business with four bows and no dance for three days or more; after enshrinement was complete, attendance returned to normal protocol.

sentences.zh: 簾前通事以內侍，殿下以閣門。

translations.literal: Before the curtain, general affairs were handled by eunuchs; below the hall, by the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: Before the curtain eunuchs handled announcements; below the hall the gate office did.

sentences.zh: 吏部磨勘奏舉人，垂簾日引。

translations.literal: When the Ministry of Personnel reviewed and reported nominees, on curtain days they were led in.
translations.idiomatic: Personnel Ministry review of nominees was conducted on curtain days.

sentences.zh: 應見、謝、辭臣僚遇朔、望參日不坐，並先詣殿門，次內東門，應抬賜者並門賜之。

translations.literal: Officials who should have audience, thanks, or leave-taking, if they encountered new-moon or full-moon attendance days when court was not held, all first went to the hall gate, then the inner eastern gate; those who should receive carried gifts were all granted them at the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Officials due for audience, thanks, or farewell on new- or full-moon days when court was not held went first to the hall gate, then the inner eastern gate; carried gifts were bestowed at the gate.

sentences.zh: 於是帝御迎陽門幄殿，同太皇太后垂簾，宰臣、親王以下合班起居。

translations.literal: Thereupon the emperor held the screen tent hall at the Welcome-the-Sun Gate, together with the grand empress dowager behind the curtain; the chief councilor, imperial princes, and below combined formations for attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the emperor held court in the tent hall at the Welcome-the-Sun Gate with the grand empress dowager behind the curtain; chief councilors, princes, and others attended in combined formation.

sentences.zh: 常制分班十六，至是合班，以閣門奏請故也。

translations.literal: The regular regulation had sixteen separate formations; at this time they combined formations, because the palace gate had reported and requested it.
translations.idiomatic: The usual sixteen separate formations were combined at the gate office’s request.

sentences.zh: 禮官請如有祥瑞、邊捷，宰臣以下紫宸殿稱賀皇帝畢，赴內東門賀太皇太后。

translations.literal: Ritual officials requested that if there were auspicious omens or frontier victories, after the chief councilor and below offered congratulations to the emperor at the Hall of Purple Eminence, they should go to the inner eastern gate to congratulate the grand empress dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officials proposed that after congratulating the emperor at the Hall of Purple Eminence for auspicious omens or frontier victories, officials should also congratulate the grand empress dowager at the inner eastern gate.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was adopted.

sentences.zh: 皇太子元正、冬至受群臣賀儀。

translations.literal: The crown prince’s rite for receiving congratulations from the hundred officials on New Year’s Day and winter solstice.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince Receiving Officials’ Congratulations on New Year’s Day and the Winter Solstice

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》：前一日，有司於東門外量地之宜，設三公以下文武群官等次如常儀；

translations.literal: “New Rites of Zhenghe”: On the day before, the responsible offices outside the eastern gate measured suitable ground and set ranks for the three dukes and below, civil and military mass officials, as in the usual rite;
translations.idiomatic: New Rites of Zhenghe: The day before, officials set ranks outside the eastern gate for the three dukes and below among civil and military officials, as usual;

sentences.zh: 典儀設皇太子答拜褥位於階下，南向，又設文武群官版位於門之外。

translations.literal: the master of ceremonies set the crown prince’s return-bow mat position below the steps, facing south; he also set the civil and military mass officials’ tally-board positions outside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: the master of ceremonies placed the crown prince’s return-bow mat below the steps facing south and officials’ tally positions outside the gate.

sentences.zh: 其日，禮直官、舍人先引三公以下文武群臣以次入，就位立定。

translations.literal: On that day, ritual duty officers and palace secretaries first led the three dukes and below, civil and military hundred officials, to enter in order and take position standing fixed.
translations.idiomatic: That day ritual officers and secretaries led the three dukes and civil and military officials in to take position.

sentences.zh: 禮直官、舍人引左庶子詣皇太子前，跪請內嚴；

translations.literal: Ritual duty officers and palace secretaries led the left aide to the crown prince’s presence; kneeling, he requested inner readiness;
translations.idiomatic: Ritual officers and secretaries led the left aide to the crown prince, who knelt to request inner readiness;

sentences.zh: 少頃，又言外備。

translations.literal: After a short while, he again said the outer was ready.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward he announced that the outer court was ready.

sentences.zh: 內侍褰簾，皇太子常服出次，左右侍衛如常儀。

translations.literal: Eunuchs raised the curtain; the crown prince in ordinary dress came out to the side chamber; left and right attendants as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs raised the curtain; the crown prince in ordinary dress emerged to the side chamber with attendants as usual.

sentences.zh: 皇太子降階詣南向褥位，典儀曰“再拜”，讚者承傳曰“再拜”，三公以下皆再拜，皇太子答拜。

translations.literal: The crown prince descended the steps and went to the south-facing mat position; the master of ceremonies said “Bow twice”; the announcer transmitted “Bow twice”; the three dukes and below all bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince descended to the south-facing mat; the master of ceremonies and announcer called for double bows; the three dukes and below bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 班首少前稱賀云：“元正首祚

translations.literal: The formation head advanced slightly and offered congratulations, saying: “On the first fortune of the new year
translations.idiomatic: The lead official stepped forward and said, “On the first fortune of the new year

sentences.zh: （冬至云“天正長至”）〉

translations.literal: (on winter solstice say “Heaven’s correct long reach”))
translations.idiomatic: (on the winter solstice say “Heaven’s correct long reach”)

sentences.zh: ，景福維新。

translations.literal: , blessings renewed.
translations.idiomatic: , blessings are renewed.

sentences.zh: 伏惟皇太子殿下，與時同休。

translations.literal: We respectfully wish that Your Highness the Crown Prince shares rest with the seasons
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully wish Your Highness the Crown Prince peace in keeping with the season

sentences.zh: ”賀訖，少退，復位。

translations.literal: ” When congratulations were finished, he withdrew slightly and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: ” When congratulations ended, he withdrew slightly and returned to position.

sentences.zh: 左庶子前，承命詣群臣前答云：“元正首祚

translations.literal: The left aide advanced; receiving the command, he went before the hundred officials and replied, saying: “On the first fortune of the new year
translations.idiomatic: The left aide advanced, received the command, and replied before the officials, “On the first fortune of the new year

sentences.zh: （冬至云“天正長至”）〉

translations.literal: (on winter solstice say “Heaven’s correct long reach”))
translations.idiomatic: (on the winter solstice say “Heaven’s correct long reach”)

sentences.zh: ，與公等均慶。

translations.literal: , I share congratulations equally with you lords.”
translations.idiomatic: , I share the celebration equally with you all.”

sentences.zh: ”典儀曰“再拜”，班首以下皆再拜，皇太子答拜。

translations.literal: ” The master of ceremonies said “Bow twice”; the formation head and below all bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow.
translations.idiomatic: ” The master of ceremonies called for double bows; the lead official and those below bowed twice; the crown prince returned the bow.

sentences.zh: 訖，禮直官、通事舍人引三公以下文武百官以次出，內侍引皇太子升階，還次，降簾，侍衛如常儀。

translations.literal: When finished, ritual duty officers and general-affairs palace secretaries led the three dukes and below, civil and military hundred officials, to go out in order; eunuchs led the crown prince to ascend the steps, return to the side chamber, lower the curtain; attendants as in the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, ritual officers and secretaries led officials out in order; eunuchs led the crown prince upstairs, back to the side chamber; the curtain was lowered; attendants withdrew as usual.

sentences.zh: 少頃，禮直官、舍人引知樞密院官以下入，就位立定，內侍引皇太子降階，詣南向褥位，樞密以下參賀如上儀。

translations.literal: After a short while, ritual duty officers and palace secretaries led privy council officials and below to enter, take position, and stand fixed; eunuchs led the crown prince to descend the steps and go to the south-facing mat position; the privy council and below offered congratulations as in the superior rite above.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward ritual officers led privy council officials in; eunuchs led the crown prince down to the south-facing mat; the privy council offered congratulations as above.

sentences.zh: 訖，退。

translations.literal: When finished, they withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When finished, they withdrew.

sentences.zh: 次引師、傅、保、賓客以下入，就位，參賀如上儀。

translations.literal: Next were led the tutor, mentor, protector, guest-friends, and below to enter, take position, and offer congratulations as in the rite above.
translations.idiomatic: Next tutors, mentors, protectors, and guest-friends entered, took position, and offered congratulations as above.

sentences.zh: 師、傅、保以下以次出。

translations.literal: The tutor, mentor, protector, and below went out in order.
translations.idiomatic: Tutors, mentors, protectors, and those below withdrew in order.

sentences.zh: 內侍引皇太子升坐，禮直官引文武宮官入，就位，重行北向立，典儀曰“再拜”，在位官皆再拜。

translations.literal: Eunuchs led the crown prince to ascend and sit; ritual duty officers led civil and military palace officials to enter, take position, stand in double rows facing north; the master of ceremonies said “Bow twice”; officials in position all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuchs led the crown prince to his seat; ritual officers led palace civil and military officials in to stand in double rows facing north; the master of ceremonies called for double bows and all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 左庶子少前，跪言：“具官某言：元正首祚

translations.literal: The left aide advanced slightly, knelt, and said: “The official so-and-so says: On the first fortune of the new year
translations.idiomatic: The left aide stepped forward, knelt, and said, “Your servant [name] says: On the first fortune of the new year

sentences.zh: （冬至云“天正長至 ”）〉

translations.literal: (on winter solstice say “Heaven’s correct long reach”))
translations.idiomatic: (on the winter solstice say “Heaven’s correct long reach”)

sentences.zh: ，伏惟皇太子殿下，與時同休。

translations.literal: , we respectfully wish that Your Highness the Crown Prince shares rest with the seasons.”
translations.idiomatic: , we respectfully wish Your Highness the Crown Prince peace in keeping with the season.”

sentences.zh: ”俯伏，興，復位。

translations.literal: ” Prostrate, he rose, and returned to position.
translations.idiomatic: ” He prostrated himself, rose, and returned to position.

sentences.zh: 典儀曰“再拜”，在位者皆再拜，分東西序立。

translations.literal: The master of ceremonies said “Bow twice”; those in position all bowed twice and split east and west to stand in order.
translations.idiomatic: The master of ceremonies called for double bows; all bowed twice and formed ranks east and west.

sentences.zh: 左庶子少前，跪言禮畢。

translations.literal: The left aide advanced slightly, knelt, and said the rite was complete.
translations.idiomatic: The left aide stepped forward, knelt, and announced that the rite was complete.

sentences.zh: 左右近侍降簾，皇太子降坐，宮官退，左右侍衛以次出。

translations.literal: Left and right close attendants lowered the curtain; the crown prince descended from the seat; palace officials withdrew; left and right attendants went out in order.
translations.idiomatic: Close attendants lowered the curtain; the crown prince left his seat; palace officials withdrew; attendants filed out in order.

sentences.zh: 皇太子與百官相見。

translations.literal: The crown prince met the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince Meets the Hundred Officials

sentences.zh: 至道元年，有司言：“百官見皇太子，自兩省五品、尚書省御史台四品、諸司三品以上皆答拜，餘悉受拜。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhidao, the responsible offices said: “When the hundred officials see the crown prince, from the two provinces fifth rank, Secretariat and Censorate fourth rank, various bureaus third rank and above—all return the bow; the rest all receive bows.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao 1, officials reported, “When officials meet the crown prince, those of fifth rank and above in the two provinces, fourth rank and above in the Secretariat and Censorate, and third rank and above in other bureaus return his bow; all others receive his bow.

sentences.zh: 宮官自左右庶子以下，悉用參見之儀。

translations.literal: Palace officials from the left and right aides down all used the audience-visit rite.
translations.idiomatic: Palace officials from the left and right aides down all used the audience-visit protocol.

sentences.zh: 其宴會位在王公上。

translations.literal: At banquets their position was above the kings and dukes.
translations.idiomatic: At banquets he sat above kings and dukes.

translations.literal: ” (close of memorial quotation).
translations.idiomatic: ” (end of report).

sentences.zh: 與師、傅、保相見。

translations.literal: Meeting the tutor, mentor, and protector.
translations.idiomatic: Meeting the Tutor, Mentor, and Protector

sentences.zh: 《政和新儀》：前一日，所司設師、傅、保以下次與宮門外道，西南向；

translations.literal: “New Rites of Zhenghe”: On the day before, the responsible office set positions for the tutor, mentor, protector, and below outside the palace gate road, facing southwest;
translations.idiomatic: New Rites of Zhenghe: The day before, officials set positions for tutors, mentors, protectors, and those below outside the palace gate, facing southwest;

sentences.zh: 設軒架之樂於殿庭，近南，北向。

translations.literal: set elevated-rack music in the palace courtyard, near the south, facing north.
translations.idiomatic: and placed elevated-rack musicians in the courtyard near the south, facing north.

sentences.zh: 其日質明，諸衛率各勒所部屯門列仗，典謁設皇太子位於殿東階下西向，設師、傅、保位，於殿西階之西，三少位於傅、保之南稍卻，俱東向北上。

translations.literal: When that day grew light, each commandant of the guards ordered his command to camp at the gate and array guard formations; the master of audiences set the crown prince’s position below the eastern steps of the hall facing west; set positions for tutor, mentor, and protector west of the western steps of the hall; the three juniors’ positions south of mentor and protector slightly back—all facing east with north as superior.
translations.idiomatic: At daybreak each guard commandant posted his command at the gate; the master of audiences placed the crown prince below the eastern steps facing west, tutors west of the western steps, and the three junior mentors south of them slightly back—all facing east with seniority to the north.

sentences.zh: 師、傅、保以下俱朝服至宮門，通事舍人引就次，左庶子請內嚴。

translations.literal: The tutor, mentor, protector, and below all in court dress came to the palace gate; the general-affairs palace secretary led them to their positions; the left aide requested inner readiness.
translations.idiomatic: Tutors, mentors, protectors, and those below arrived at the gate in court dress; the general-affairs secretary led them to position; the left aide requested inner readiness.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引師、傅、保立於正殿門之西，三少在其南稍卻，俱東向北上。

translations.literal: The general-affairs palace secretary led the tutor, mentor, and protector to stand west of the main hall gate; the three juniors south of them slightly back—all facing east with north as superior.
translations.idiomatic: The general-affairs secretary led tutors, mentors, and protectors to stand west of the main gate, with the three junior mentors south of them slightly back—all facing east with seniority to the north.

sentences.zh: 左庶子言外備，諸侍奉之官各服其器服，俱詣閣奉迎。

translations.literal: The left aide said the outer was ready; each attending service official donned his ritual implements and dress, all going to the pavilion to receive and escort.
translations.idiomatic: The left aide announced the outer court was ready; attending officials donned their ritual regalia and went to the pavilion to receive the crown prince.

sentences.zh: 皇太子朝服以出，左右侍衛如常儀，軒架作《翼安之樂》，至東階下西向立，樂止。

translations.literal: The crown prince in court dress came out; left and right attendants as in the usual rite; elevated-rack music played “Music of Assisting Peace”; reaching below the eastern steps he stood facing west; music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince emerged in court dress with attendants as usual; musicians played “Assisting Peace”; he stood below the eastern steps facing west, and the music stopped.

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引師、傅、保及三少入，就位，軒架作《正安之樂》，至位樂止。

translations.literal: The general-affairs palace secretary led the tutor, mentor, protector, and three juniors in; they took position; elevated-rack music played “Music of Correct Peace”; when they reached position music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The general-affairs secretary led tutors, mentors, protectors, and the three junior mentors in; musicians played “Correct Peace” until they reached position.

sentences.zh: 皇太子再拜，師、傅、保以下答拜

translations.literal: The crown prince bowed twice; the tutor, mentor, protector, and below returned the bow
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince bowed twice; tutors, mentors, protectors, and those below returned the bow

sentences.zh: （若三少特見，則三少先拜）〉

translations.literal: (if the three juniors were received separately, then the three juniors bowed first))
translations.idiomatic: (if the three junior mentors were received separately, they bowed first)

sentences.zh: 通事舍人引師、傅、保以下出，軒架《正安之樂》作，出門，樂止。

translations.literal: The general-affairs palace secretary led the tutor, mentor, protector, and below out; elevated-rack music “Music of Correct Peace” played; when they went out the gate, music stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The general-affairs secretary led tutors, mentors, protectors, and those below out to “Correct Peace”; music stopped at the gate.

sentences.zh: 左庶子前跪稱：“左庶子某言，禮畢。

translations.literal: The left aide advanced, knelt, and said: “The left aide so-and-so says, the rite is complete.
translations.idiomatic: The left aide advanced, knelt, and said, “Your servant [name], left aide, reports that the rite is complete.

sentences.zh: ”皇太子入，左右侍衛及樂作如來儀。

translations.literal: ” The crown prince entered; left and right attendants and music performed as on the coming rite.
translations.idiomatic: ” The crown prince entered; attendants and music followed the arrival protocol.
